# 5 bedroom detached house for sale

> Guide Price £600,000-£650,000. Offered with no onward chain and occupying a wonderfully private position beyond the final turning on the highly sought-after Gunton Church Lane, this outstanding contemporary residence has been extensively remodelled and significantly extended to create a home of exceptional quality and style.
